gloss: to blow a blizzard; to snow heavily with wind

definitions.gloss: to blow a blizzard; to snow heavily with strong wind
definitions.explanation: Describes weather conditions where snow falls heavily accompanied by strong winds, creating blizzard-like conditions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{吹雪|ふぶ}いて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
{吹雪|ふぶ}いて⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えない→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: The blizzard is so bad I can't see ahead.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{吹雪|ふぶ}いて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{中止|ちゅうし}した→中止する：21909_chuushisuru⟧。
examples.english: It had been blowing a fierce blizzard on the mountain since morning, so we called off the climb.

notes:
The verb form of the noun ⟦{吹雪|ふぶき}→吹雪：00040_fubuki⟧ (blizzard). Used impersonally to describe weather conditions, similar to how English uses "it's snowing" or "it's blowing."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{吹雪|ふぶ}く: to blow a fierce blizzard
- {吹雪|ふぶ}き{始|はじ}める: to start blizzarding
- ⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧{吹雪|ふぶ}いて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧: it was a blizzard all day

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{吹雪|ふぶき}→吹雪：00040_fubuki⟧: blizzard (noun)
- ⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧: to snow (without strong wind)
- ⟦{猛吹雪|もうふぶき}→猛吹雪：21266_moufubuki⟧: severe blizzard
